navigation.model: Design-system pages: top documentation bar with Foundations, Components, Templates, Screens, Validation. Buyer pages: left sidebar from ps.js NAV (Home; Procurement; Supplier Management; Sourcing; Contracts; Invoicing; Reports & Analytics; User Management; Item Master; Master Data Management; Administration), collapsible to 64px, drawer under 905px. Supplier pages: left rail with Home, Invitations, Orders, Shipments. Buyer and supplier pages share a page banner above the content: breadcrumbs and the page title on the left, approvals, notifications, Ask Me (buyer) and Refresh on the right. Item Master has Item requests, Item master, Bulk upload, Request by chat and Item insights; its request, review, approval and record pages are reached from rows and next-step buttons. Record and form pages are reached from workbench rows, drawers and page actions.
